name: nadi_wear
source: docs/12-quarter-1-reference.md §1, with per-line constants from §2.7, §4.4, §5.1, §5.4, §6.4 and baselines from §5-§7

equipment_depreciation.note: Rs 25,00,000 (Q1 close, docs/12 §11) -> Rs 20,00,000 (Q3 start, docs/14 §1) over two quarterly steps. No depreciation rule is stated in docs/ -- this is a straight-line fit, not a designer-confirmed formula.

repeat_purchase_rate_derivation.note: Back-solved exactly, not curve-fitted: docs/13-quarter-2-reference.md §1 states Q2 opens at 19.0%, and Q1's three contributions at their stated spends are Email 3x1.60^0.5 = 3.7947, Onboarding 3x1.25^0.4 = 3.2801, CX Team 2x0.90^0.4 = 1.9175, summing to 8.9923. 19.0 - 8.9923 = 10.0077, a 0.0077 residual against a round 10.0. Stronger evidence than the fitted brand multiplier or the inferred CX conversion term -- those fit a curve to data points, this inverts stated arithmetic -- but still not a directly stated value, hence the flag.

notes.cumulative_scores_open_at_zero: brand_score, seo_asset, buzz_score, quality_score, innovation_score and feature_completeness are not stated as Q1 opening values, but are derivable: docs/13-quarter-2-reference.md §1 opens Q2 at exactly the amount Q1 built (Brand 8.7, SEO 4.5, Buzz 5.5, Quality 9.95, Innovation 7.5), so Q1 opened at zero for each.
notes.repeat_purchase_rate_pct: 10.0, back-solved from docs/13's stated Q2 opening of 19.0% rather than stated directly -- see repeat_purchase_rate_derivation for the full arithmetic and why this is a stronger class of inference than the fitted brand multiplier.
notes.attrition_rate_pct: Zero because docs/12-quarter-1-reference.md §6.2 states attrition has no effect in Q1 -- it erodes capacity built in a prior quarter, and Q1 has none.
notes.base_conversion_rate_pct: The starting point for raw conversion, before the R&D ceiling caps it: raw = base + Reps bonus + CRM bonus + CX Team's repeat-rate bonus, and the final rate is MIN(raw, ceiling) + warranty bonus. In Q1 raw reaches 27.25% and the 19.11% ceiling binds -- see the CX-in-raw-conversion entry in docs/10-implementation-gaps.md.
notes.equipment_nbv_inr: Rs 25,00,000 is the value docs/12-quarter-1-reference.md §11's asset identity requires at Q1 close; nothing in docs/ states a separate pre-Q1 balance, so it is seeded as this quarter's opening (undepreciated-within-Q1) figure, matching how fixed_costs_inr is only discounted for the quarter that inherits it.
notes.sourced_but_not_modelled: §1 also states a 22,000-signup waitlist and a 2,50,000/quarter market ceiling. Neither feeds any formula in the execution chain, so neither is seeded.
